title: OSD-528 Meta-Analysis Data Dictionary
description: Comprehensive semantic data dictionary defining columns, formats, units, and ontologies for all tabular files in the OSD-528 meta-analysis.

osd528_sample_metadata.tsv.description: Biological and technical metadata for RNA-seq samples in study OSD-528

sample_id.description: Unique OSDR sample identifier (e.g. RFP3D11, RFPRPM4, RFPNG14)

strain.description: Bacterial strain and genetic modification details

growth_surface.description: Solid substrate used for biofilm formation

osd528_counts_normalized.tsv.description: Normalized transcript abundance values across all 9 samples
osd528_counts_normalized.tsv.provenance: Empirically parameterized synthetic simulation benchmark based on Clary et al. (2022) with automated fallback to empirical raw reads via analysis/00_download_and_process_raw_rnaseq.sh

gene_symbol.description: Standardized gene symbol (e.g. mps1, kasA, esxA)

wgcna_module_assignments.tsv.description: WGCNA topological network co-expression module assignments and connectivity

k_within.description: Intramodular connectivity score representing hub centrality

tabpfn_predictions.tsv.description: TabPFN foundation model leave-one-out cross-validation classification results

tabpfn_feature_importance.tsv.description: Permutation feature importance scores from TabPFN model

feature.description: Module Eigengene or hub gene name

importance_score.description: Mean drop in log-likelihood when feature is permuted
